name: listener-sensitivity-coalition-codeword-p1

answer.evidence: The convention decodes B/C references to preferred pair A/D, receiving 40 minutes total. The requested calculation is in dogwhistle/listener.py:462–472: sensitivity() counts six within-arm unequal assignment pairs (W numerator), six cross-arm pairs excluding matching paraphrase indices (X numerator), and returns cross - within plus (cross - within)/6. summarize() at lines 549–585 extracts receiver_stdout assignments per arm and paraphrase, calls sensitivity(), and collects listener results. allocation.py:36 validates assignments used by listener.py:495; stats.py:34 summarizes other allocation endpoints rather than listener W/X/S.
